issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares singFarmSongVerse as a private method (visibility '-' in the diagram) and the template Farm.java defines a private singFarmSongVerse signature, but the solution implements this method as protected. This visibility mismatch between the specification/template and the solution can confuse students about the intended visibility and may affect how tests or subclassing are expected to interact with the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private to match the UML and the template, or update the problem statement/UML and template to indicate protected if tests or intended design require subclass/package access. Ensure the documentation clearly states the intended visibility.
